name: bld5_pisano_lucas_odd_eq
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (ho : Odd n) : p3_pisano (p3_lucas n) = 2 * n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (ho : Odd n), p3_pisano (p3_lucas n) = 2 * n
informal: Uses Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period, Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period, Mathlib2.lib_fib_cassini_cast and Mathlib2.lib_p3_lucas_cast: F_{2n} = F_n·L_n ≡ 0 (Nat.fib_two_mul) and F_{2n+1} = F_{n+1}·L_n − (−1)^n ≡ 1 mod L_n for odd n (lib_p3_lucas_cast, Nat.fib_two_mul_add_one, lib_fib_cassini_cast); so lib_fib_period_iff + bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period give π ∣ 2n (improving bld4_pisano_lucas_dvd_four_mul). Conversely lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period (i = 0) gives L_n ∣ F_π, hence by Nat.fib_gcd L_n ∣ F_{gcd(π,2n)}; F_{n+1} < L_n forces gcd(π, 2n) ≥ n + 2, and the only divisor of 2n above n is 2n, so 2n ∣ π.
source: builds on Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff, Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period, Mathlib2.lib_pisano_dvd_iff_period, Mathlib2.lib_fib_cassini_cast, Mathlib2.lib_p3_lucas_cast
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 3 ≤ n → Odd n → Mathlib2.p3_pisano (Mathlib2.p3_lucas n) = 2 * n
